title: UI/UX Designer for mental health app
description:
Objective: Design the UI/UX of an iOS app that focuses on singles and motivates them to work on themselves through mood tracking, personalized content, and goal-setting features.

UI/UX Requirements:

Onboarding process:
a. Welcome screen with an overview of the app and its benefits.
b. A series of screens to capture user preferences, including gender, age range, and interests.
c. Optional screen to set initial goals or areas of self-improvement.
d. A short tutorial highlighting key features and navigation tips.

Home screen:
a. Top section featuring the user's current mood, displayed as an emoticon or visual representation (e.g., a color-coded mood bar).
b. Below the mood display, a prompt for users to update their mood and add notes.
c. A personalized content feed featuring motivational quotes, articles, videos, and other resources tailored to the user's mood, preferences, and self-improvement goals. Content cards should include a title, a brief description, and an eye-catching thumbnail.
d. A "Daily Challenge" card to encourage users to complete a self-improvement task, such as journaling or exercise.

Navigation menu:
a. A bottom navigation bar with icons for Home, Goals, Progress, and Settings.
b. Home icon: Directs users to the Home screen.
c. Goals icon: Directs users to the Goals screen where they can create, edit, and track personal goals.
d. Progress icon: Directs users to the Progress screen, displaying mood history and goal achievements.
e. Settings icon: Directs users to the Settings screen to manage preferences, notifications, and subscriptions.

Goals screen:
a. A list of the user's active goals, displayed as cards with a title, description, and progress bar.
b. A floating action button (FAB) to create a new goal, prompting a goal creation form with fields for title, description, start date, end date, and optional milestones.
c. Swipe functionality to delete, edit, or mark a goal as complete.

Progress screen:
a. A mood history section displaying the user's mood data over time as a line chart, with options to filter by day, week, month, or custom date range.
b. A goal achievements section showcasing completed goals as a list, with options to view details, share achievements, or restart a goal.

Settings screen:
a. Profile management section to edit personal information, upload a profile picture, and set privacy preferences.
b. Notification preferences section for users to customize the frequency and types of reminders they receive.
c. Subscription management section for users to upgrade to a premium plan, view billing details, and manage payment methods.

Design Specifications:

Clean, modern design with easy-to-use interface
Calming, neutral color palette with occasional pops of color to highlight important elements
Custom illustrations and icons to create a unique and engaging user experience
Consistent typography and spacing to ensure readability and visual harmony
Use of subtle animations and transitions to enhance interactivity and user engagement
Design should be responsive and adapt well to various screen sizes and orientations
Please ensure that the final design is provided in a format compatible with iOS app development, such as Sketch or Adobe XD files, including all assets (icons, images, fonts) required for implementation.

Us: A dynamic team of marketing and software professionals building software to delight our clients and bring real world value. The whole team is fully remote and we are around 30 to 40 strong. We build campaigns, WordPress websites and plugins, custom tools and we have our own product that is built on PHP using Laravel for the back-end, and Vue.js for the front-end.

- Developing/modifying custom WordPress themes and plugins.
- In-depth knowledge of Laravel, PHP, MYSQL, JS(jQuery), CSS, and HTML.
- Good understanding of version control using git.

- Knowledge of WordPress coding standards.
- Working experience with Gutenberg (e.g creating dynamic blocks).
- Proficient in English communication.

GoodToHave:

- Remote working experience.
- Knowledge of WordPress Unit Testing (PHPUnit).
- Experience with WordPress's core contributions.
- Author of WordPress Plugins/Themes on WordPress.org.

Experience:
- Minimum of 5-7 years of work experience as a WordPress back-end developer.
- Experience with popular WordPress plugins 
- Experience working with APIs.
- Minimum 5 years of experience in plugin development and customization.

High energy: You are excited to be working as a part of a fully remote team creating cool products
Excellent communicator: You speak English fluently on daily video calls
Self driven: You want to improve your skills and your value to the team

PLEASE SAVE OUR TIME AND YOUR TIME BY READING THIS. WE WILL ONLY HIRE THOSE ...
... that are prepared to work Monday thru Friday, 7am to 4pm Pacific USA time (UTC -8)
... with a demonstrable high-speed internet connection
... that speak English fluently and are easy to understand
... with high-energy, self-driven and have an obvious passion for finding solutions to problems systematically
... that are excellent and clear communicators
... with demonstrable WP, Server & PHP coding skills

We've been doing this long enough to know what type of people will fit into this team. Please don't waste our time or your time if this isn't you.

How this will work:

The right candidates for this job will write a compelling but short cover letter that impresses us with your story. How did you get to this point in your career and why are you applying for this job. Those without a cover letter will be declined.

Second our TPM will interview several candidates on a video call for around 5 to 10 minutes each. If your connection is spotty, if you microphone is hard to understand, if you are in a dark room and it's hard to see you - He'll quickly just skip to the next candidate. The candidates that pass this step will truly be those that are high energy and excellent English communicators.

Third step will be an interview with our Team Leader/Technical Advisor. This will also be a video call and will last from 15 to 45 mins on average. There will probably be some screen sharing going on. 

The successful candidate will start with one of the following problems as a trial to see if we work well together:

1. WP sites have page load failures (perhaps conflicting plug-ins - we need to test, establish issue and solve)
2. WP site/page downtime needs to be reported though an automated system - we have one but it needs to be updated or replaced
3. WP spam protection fails frequently and also catches non-spam - fix or replace

If these kinds of projects leave you cold, please do not apply.

If you got a little excited when reading those projects, this is probably for you and we'll hear from you soon.

Don't hesitate to tell us of your experience fixing similar problems in the past.

Looking forward to hearing from the right candidates - you know who you are!

Dear Developer,

We are looking for a skilled and experienced developer who specializes in page speed optimization and core web vitals. Our goal is to create a new service line that offers page speed optimization to clients and prospects, which will help our agency stand out in a crowded market. 

We view this service line as a perfect introduction offer to our other services.

You should also have experience with tools such as GTmetrix, Pingdom, Google PageSpeed Insights, and other optimization tools. Familiarity with Google's Core Web Vitals and the latest SEO trends is essential.

Your main responsibility will be to build a comprehensive offering that can go to market. This includes everything from determining pricing and creating a pricing strategy to developing the necessary processes and systems to deliver the service efficiently and effectively.

We want you to design a systemized series of services that are fast, highly scalable, and efficient in their delivery and value to the client. This should include a clear process for onboarding clients, conducting website speed audits, implementing optimizations, and ongoing monitoring and reporting.

As a part of this project, we also challenge you to create a prototype or wireframes of the homepage of a new website that will offer these services. This site should be designed to be visually appealing, easy to navigate, and optimized for speed.

Finally briefly describe a go to market marketing plan on how you would launch this new offering.

Our goal is to find a commercially-minded developer who can partner with our agency and help us build a new service line that will attract new clients and prospects. If you have the necessary skills and experience, we would love to hear from you.

Thank you for your time, and we look forward to hearing from you soon.

Best regards

- Strong knowledge of Google Tag Manager, including the ability to create custom tags, triggers, and variables.
- Familiarity with pixel tracking best practices, data privacy regulations, and website analytics.
- Experience with reporting tools such as Data Studio, Excel, or Power BI.
- Experience with setting up and configuring Google Analytics 4.
- Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with other teams.
- Attention to detail and ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues related to pixel tracking and analytics.
- This is a short-term freelance position with a flexible work schedule. The successful candidate will be compensated based on their level of experience and the scope of the project.

title: Social media marketing manager
description:
Company: PRVTE LONDON LTD

Location: London, England

PRVTE LONDON, a fast-growing men's fashion brand, is seeking a highly creative and experienced Social Media Marketing Manager to elevate our online presence. As a Social Media Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for developing and implementing our social media strategy, with a focus on Instagram and TikTok, to increase brand awareness, drive customer engagement, and boost sales within the men's fashion niche. This role requires strong communication skills, a deep understanding of social media platforms, and a passion for men's fashion.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Develop and implement a comprehensive social media strategy tailored to the men's fashion industry, aligning with our brand identity, target audience, and business goals.
2. Create and curate daily high-quality content for Instagram and TikTok that showcases our men's fashion line and resonates with our audience, driving engagement and sales.
3. Monitor and analyze social media metrics to inform data-driven decisions and adjust strategies as needed to optimize performance.
4, Cultivate relationships with influencers within the men's fashion space and manage all aspects of influencer marketing, including outreach, negotiation, and contract execution.
5. Maintain a consistent brand voice across all social media platforms, adapting to platform-specific nuances while showcasing the latest men's fashion trends.
6. Engage with our online community by responding to comments, messages, and reviews in a timely and professional manner, fostering a sense of loyalty and trust.
7. Coordinate with the marketing, design, and customer support teams to ensure consistent messaging and seamless customer experience across all touch points.
8. Stay current with social media trends, platform updates, and industry news within the men's fashion sector to continuously improve our social media strategy and campaigns.
9. Manage the social media content calendar, ensuring timely and coordinated content publication.
Collaborate with the marketing team on the creation and execution of social media advertising campaigns to drive targeted results within the men's fashion niche.

Qualifications:

1. Minimum 3 years of experience in social media marketing or a similar role, with a strong focus on Instagram and TikTok.
2. Proven track record of creating and implementing successful social media strategies and campaigns within the men's fashion industry.
3. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create compelling and engaging content tailored to men's fashion.
4. In-depth understanding of social media platform algorithms and best practices for maximizing reach and engagement within the men's fashion niche.
5. Experience with influencer marketing in the men's fashion industry, including outreach, negotiation, and contract management.
6. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and meet deadlines.
7. Familiarity with social media management tools (e.g., Hootsuite, Buffer) and analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Instagram Insights).
8. A self-starter who is comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
9. Passion for staying current with the latest social media trends, platform updates, and men's fashion industry news.

To apply for this position, please submit your resume, cover letter, and a portfolio showcasing your best work on Instagram and TikTok within the men's fashion niche. We look forward to learning more about how your creativity, expertise, and passion for men's fashion and social media can help PRVTE LONDON thrive in the competitive digital landscape.

Experience with visual (2D, 3D), textual, lexical and hybrid knowledge representations (concept maps, notion.so, etc.). 4. At least basic understanding of Deep Learning (DL) acceleration techniques, eXplainable AI (XAI), Self- and Semi-Supervised Learning (SSL), Graph-ConvNets, Probabilistic Logic Network (PLNs), Probabilistic Soft Logic (PSL), probabilistic programming, Neural Architecture Search (NAS), Capsule Networks, Hierarchical Temporal Memory (HTM), large memory layers with product keys, gcForest, corporate memory architectures, big data, constraints, cognitive architectures, chatbots, neural machine translation, multi-head attention, visual reasoning, Recurrent Independent Mechanisms (RIMs), Working Memory Graph (WMG). 5. title: Application Development for Food Delivery Service Order Desirability
description:
Project involves building a mobile application for accepting food delivery orders from multiple food delivery services (Door Dash, Uber Eats, Grub Hub) and automating the process of accepting orders based on certain criteria.

The application will need to have a user profile setup feature where users can enter their name, email address, and cell phone number. The app will also need to have user account features for tracking billing and earnings.

The main functionality of the app is to observe incoming delivery orders and calculate a "Desirability Ratio" for each order based on the earnings amount and the distance to the drop-off location. The app will then determine whether to accept or reject the order based on this ratio, as well as the market area (within 10 miles from the first order) and the order's rank based on the time it was accepted relative to other orders.

The app will also provide a mapping interface for users to view the location of the vendor and the drop-off location of the orders, and the orders will be ranked in order of acceptance and delivery time.

Based on the specifications, the app will need to be built for multiple platforms including IOS, Windows, Edge, Android, and Chrome. The app will also need to be able to interact with multiple food delivery services APIs (Door Dash, Uber Eats, Grub Hub) to receive incoming orders and send acceptance responses.

In terms of the technologies to use, Java can be used for the backend logic of the app, and for the mobile app development, Swift can be used for the IOS version of the app, while a cross-platform development tool such as React Native or Xamarin can be used for developing the app on Windows, Edge, Android, and Chrome.

Overall, the project will involve significant development effort, including building user interfaces, integrating with third-party APIs, developing backend logic, and implementing mapping features.

title: HTML / CSS / Dashboard Expert
description:
I have an internal dashboard tool that has components that are HTML code. 

The dashboard tool is similar to Tableau. We can adjust the HTML through the UI which updates the HTML. You can also adjust the HTML code directly.

A pivot table is one 'component' of the dashboard. A bar chart is another 'component' of the dashboard, for example. 

A VP may want to see one dimension of the pivot table e.g. country x metric. A manager may want to see sub-country x metric. As different users want different dimensions of the same data, we end up building multiple dashboards for different users and it is a maintenance nightmare. 

What would be great is if we could store the username and dimension mapping somewhere e.g. 

VP1 | country 
VP2 | country + sub_country
manager1 | sub_country 
manager2 | sub_country 
manager3 | sub_country + local_country 

And then have the dashboard component dynamically update depending on the who the user is. This would reduce the burden of dashboard maintenance.

I am able to give example code of a component. The project here is to come up with a basic prototype of the use case above to demonstrate it is possible and how.

title: Amazon Flex Bot
description:
I am looking a developer who can help me build a server based block grabber bot for Amazon flex app. The details are listed below. If this is something that you can do it or have done it before please let me know how much you charge and how long it will take you to complete. If you didn't understand the requirements and how the system works, please don't apply. More info on how the system works are as follows. Previous experience preferred!

Amazon flex block grabber script
The Block Grabber script is a simple script (Python or shell) that runs on a computer. For a “production” server, the server should be extremely close to the Amazon Flex Blocks server, which is in an instance of AWS in Ashburn VA. The script logs into your Amazon Flex account, sends a command to check for blocks (the same as your refresh button on your app), decodes the block information, decides which ones to accept, then accept the specific block. All of this can occur within a few tenths of a second. In some warehouses, this process can be too long so additional scripting needs to be done in order to minimize computations and delays to beat out other scripts. Getting blocks in these warehouses can be impossible unless there are more blocks than scripts or that blocks come out last minute, preventing drivers that are not close by to accept them.

The Amazon Flex login information is not just a simple username and password. It is a digital key that is stored on your phone. You will need to set up your phone so that the internet is routed through a proxy server (your production server). The proxy server can then listen to the login command and capture the digital key. It can then be used by your script to log in. While your phone is linked to the proxy server, you can also check for blocks. The proxy server can output this information and show you what is being sent by your phone (refresh blocks) and what is sent by the Amazon Flex server (block information). Some people check this information daily to ensure that no changes are made. If your program responds with information formatted in an old way, Amazon could pick that up and detect that you are using a script.

title: Turn a python script into a web app
description:
I have a python script that scrapes data from a deals website via an API and sends the deals back to me in real time over Telegram.
The script works in several ways:
- Unfiltered mode: Monitors the entire website and sends every new deal.
- Keyword filtered mode: Monitors the website and sends only the deals that contain certain keywords defined beforehand in a text file.
- popularity filtered mode: Monitors the website and only sends deals that reach a certain level of popularity.
- filtered by % discount mode: Monitors the website and only sends deal that matching the defined percentage of discount

All these modes are configurable through a config file that I must modify before launching my script.

Currently the script is hosted on an ubuntu machine at home and each time I want to change/add a keyword or change the mode of operation I have to edit the config file or the keyword file and then restart my script. this is pretty anoying.

That's why I would like to convert this script into a Web APP in order to make it accessible on the internet with the possibility to set up its operation directly on the web APP.

To sumerize

A web site with a functionality of creating different accounts for different people.
In each profile there are parameters of telegram, and also funcionality to change set of filters for particular account.
And the bot is scraping data for each account and send it to different chats (corresponding to each account) in parralel.
With opportunity to change set of filters and enable/disable scraping for particular profile.
1- A web site with a functionality of creating different Profile for different people.
2- Each profile has his own set of parameters :
- profile name
- telegram Token
- Chat ID
- Keywords list
- Min / Max Deal Temperature
- Discount percentage
3- each profile has the right to
- manage his own set of filters
- start / stop his bot scraping
4- An admin account can manage all account and change. (start stop, change set of filters etc...)

I then expect you to drive the tutorial for the remainder of the call and answer my follow-up questions along the way. You should have an excellent understanding of how to implement the following feature set so that you can walk me through it after I share more detailed context. At a high-level, my service will have two different user types.- 
1. User type 1 arrives at the landing page and pays to sign up for the service
2. User type 1 invites other friends to join the service and assigns them to fill out a form on the service. These invited friends will be called user type 2
3. User type 1 can see a dashboard status tracker for which of their friends have submitted responses to the form
4. User type 2 signs up for the service for free using a referral/unique code in their invite link from user type 1. Only user type 1 will be charged for the service - their friends will access the service for free.
5. User type 2 will begin populating their responses to a form displayed on their home screen. The form will have short instructional videos next to each prompt so the user knows how to answer the prompt correctly, along with an option for them to upload a few pictures as the last prompt
5. Once all user type 2s have submitted their forms, user type 1 should be able to press a button on their dashboard and request all information filled out by all their friends (user type 2s) to be sent to their email in one compiled PDF in a standardized format.

title: Celery worker/consumer for AWS EventBridge Scheduler payloads
description:
We are looking for an experienced Python, Celery developer to create a Celery worker/consumer that will process scheduled messages off of an SQS queue. We would like to have something deployed in 1 - 1.5 weeks with 1 - 2 weeks of testing/tweaking.

Our current system schedules tasks with AWS EventBridge Scheduler which then puts a message onto SQS when it's time to be processed. Our consumer (Kombu) then pulls messages off the queue and processes the message. We would like to pivot to using Celery as it offers more robust capabilities. The work will be a complete re-write of the worker/consumer.

What differs between a typical Celery Worker/Consumer solution and our desired solution is that AWS EventBridge Scheduler will be placing the messages onto SQS and not a Celery app. From what we have read, this may require using bootsteps.ConsumerStep.

Tasks can run for up to 60 minutes, for this reason, the consumer should stop pulling tasks off of the queue when no processes are available.

title: Fix Shopify Backend Custom Registration (php to liquid)
description:
Currently we have a custom registration process on our Shopify site. When visitors go to the registration page they have two options (see attached step1.png):

1. (left-side) They insert a unique membership code. The code they insert could be all kinds of characters and it should not be case sensitive. So if we have the term "BenefitHub" as the membership code users can insert "benefithub" or "BENEFITHUB" or "BeNEfItHuB" they should be able to see the next step in the registration process. See all unique codes in our Apps/Accentuate Custom Fields/Shop/Edit Values. 

2. (right-side) They are a member of military, medical, first responder, teacher and they use SheerID to verify their membership with those associations. When SheerID sends back a successful response only then we consider the visitor as verified.

Once a visitor is successfully verified, by either left or right side verification option, then they are shown the account creation form (first & last name, email, password) to open a Shopify account. (see attached step2.png).

Once they have successfully created their account it is important that we store in their customer profile on Shopify how they registered. If they used a membership code (left-side) then in the customer tags we should see the membership code they used (in all caps) as well as the word 'VERIFIED'. If they registered with SheerID (right-side) then we need to see the kind of association they are a part of also in all caps (basically which button they clicked), "MILITARY" or "TEACHER" or "MEDICAL" or "FIRST RESPONDER" as well as the words "SHEERID" and "VERIFIED".

***Here is the problem we need to fix***
Currently all this is working through a php file which I will provide to you. We do not wish to host this logic on any server, but would prefer that we keep this within Shopify. If we could convert the php logic into Shopify's liquid code that would be ideal. For the membership code (left-side) I don't mind us putting the codes right into the form as a validation to show step2 if that will make it easier. We are not concerned about someone seeing the source code of this form and getting a membership code the wrong way. 

I want to make sure that the SheerID (right-side) verification can be done from within Shopify, without the need to use external php script. 

Also currently we save some SheerID information (like their unique verification id) in the Shopify customer profile meta fields. We like having it, but it is not necessary at all.

Hi, Team 

I need your help To create a Newrelic dashboard that shows an overview of the previous week with the total number of alarms open, a list of alarms triggered most frequently, and the time the alarms have been opened.

In this example, the dashboard shows the following information:
Total number of alarms open in the previous week: XXX

Top 10 alarms triggered most frequently:

 Alarm 1: alarm name
 Alarm 2: alarm name
 Alarm 3: alarm name
 Alarm 4: alarm name

 Time the alarms have been opened: A line chart shows the number of alarms opened over the previous week, with the x-axis representing the date and the y-axis representing the number of alarms. Each line represents a different alarm.

This dashboard provides an at-a-glance view of the alarms that have been triggered most frequently over the previous week, and also shows how many alarms were opened in total during that time period. The line chart provides a way to track the overall trends in alarm activity over time. 

Also need to find out which days have more alarms and what the average number of alarms per day is

In this example, the dashboard shows the following additional information:

 The number of alarms triggered on each day of the previous week: A stacked bar chart shows the number of alarms triggered on each day of the previous week, with each color representing a different alarm.
 An average number of alarms per day: A separate metric shows the average number of alarms triggered per day over the previous week.

With these additional visualizations, users can now see which days had more alarms than others and the average number of alarms per day. This information can help users identify patterns or trends in alarm activity and take appropriate actions to address any issues or concerns.

Monitor changes over time: You can monitor changes in the number of alarms triggered over time to identify trends or patterns. title: Affiliate marketing manager

We are a fast-growing e-commerce custom jewelry brand and are looking for an Affiliate Marketing Expert that will be able to provide us through a consultancy an over-all affiliate strategy that helps us bring incremental revenue from affiliate marketing.

We’d love to hear from you if the below description applies to you;

• The opportunity to build a successful affiliate program from the ground up sounds exciting. You love the thrill of watching your results go “up and to the right”.
• You know how to grow relationships – and revenue. You’re so confident in your affiliate marketing skills that you prefer to base a portion of your remuneration on revenue growth and KPIs, resulting in higher income potential.

Who We Need:

We’re looking for a highly motivated Affiliate Marketing Expert. This is an opportunity to create an affiliate program from the ground up – you’ll own the channel and the process. Processes and system’s that you introduce will be the benchmark of our affiliate marketing strategy.

The Affiliate Marketing Expert will be responsible for developing, implementing, and scaling our affiliate marketing program, it’s strategies, and systems. With a strong understanding of acquisition and growth marketing strategies, this person will manage and grow robust affiliate relationships across various categories (publishers, bloggers, rewards, creators, influencers, and more).

The individual for this role must be experienced in building and scaling B2C affiliate programs, with demonstrable experience in tracking and optimizing performance. You’ll have a strong understanding of well-known affiliate marketing solutions such as ShareASale, Impact Radius, Commission Junction, and most importantly refersion, and know how to find the right partners for our brand within these networks.

The ideal candidate for this position knows how to create compelling offers that engage audiences across a wide range of affiliates. You understand how to tailor the message for different affiliate partners to create highly converting campaigns that acquire new customers and grow revenue.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Manage the brand’s affiliate marketing strategy to meet channel goals and performance KPIs, being the go-to specialist for anything and everything affiliate marketing.
• Work closely with the product development team and other members of the marketing team to create compelling campaigns and funnels for affiliates.
• Develop affiliate recruitment and retention strategies. This includes researching and developing new affiliate partnerships and nurturing ongoing key relationships with top affiliates and other strategic partners.
• Manage affiliate relationships on outside platforms (Commission Junction), building and expanding our network as needed.
• Collaborate with the Marketing and Branding team to further develop our outreach marketing strategy.
• Develop reports on affiliate performance on a recurring basis, providing analysis and key insights to the leadership team.
• Stay up to date with the latest industry trends, new technologies, and meaningful changes in the Affiliate Marketing space.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS
• 3+ years of direct affiliate marketing or partner management experience with B2C brands, preferably in eCommerce.
• Prior experience managing affiliate network programs (Share A Sale, Commission Junction, Impact Junction, refersion) and publisher relationships with proven success.
• Track record for developing, implementing, and scaling successful affiliate marketing programs.
• Highly analytical and proficient in Excel, Google Analytics, and other analytics tools.
• Proven ability to manage and prioritize multiple detail-oriented assignments while keeping an eye on the overarching marketing objectives.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt quickly to change.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to communicate with individuals at all levels of the organization.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer needed
description:
Hello there!
I have a fully functional next.js app that facilitates a chat conversation with users. I configured and hooked it up to firebase using the very latest code patterns and have the following incompletions on my list for launch in order of priority

1 - I built my MVP in react.js without data retention and then rebuilt the same functionality into a next.js project from scratch to make it easier to integrate with firebase as a back end. It's all working except I have not refactored the API call it makes to refresh a chat conversation it facilitates. I need that API call refactored. It was totally working until the transition to next.js but in next.js requires a bit of a different style.
2 - chat history page
Currently, the app will allow for 1 chat conversation, and upon page refresh, the chat interface will reset. Instead, I need to create a function that will store the chat history in firebase ( already hooked up and handling user auth ), and then render the previous chats in a nav window menu like any typical chat app. Also like any chat app, when a user clicks on a past chat I want to load it into the screen and allow for continuing the conversation.
The app actually pulls off the MVP functionality needed for launch without this feature, but I think it would be meaningful to users. The nav menu is already built.
3 - payments page
I need to add a page to the app matching the current app style which allows for payments. This will require tracking the number of tokens purchased ( we will sell usage tokens ) and then will keep track via firebase ( already hooked up to firebase ) the number of tokens remaining. Each time the conversation continues a small number of tokens will be "used up" and I need a function that gives a notification ( already have a notification component set up ), but a function that will create a notification that brings them to this page on click when the tokens run out to refill the "gas tank" of the app.
4 - move logic to the back end.
This item I need feedback on this. I want to prevent or minimize the chances of people reverse engineering the app so my intent is to move the logic to the back end, currently, it's in the front end. My research indicates this will help make it harder for reverse engineering. I need confirmation of this. I am using firebase for the back end and they now have that feature, just need someone to go through the motions.

If you feel very confident you can complete these tasks please let me know with an application to this contract. It will most likely result in ongoing work. Native English speaking is a hard requirement, and meetings will take place during EST hours. I will likely have up to 40 hrs a week of work available to you if you desire it and are effective and expedient in coding.

title: Chrome Extension for Generating GPT-3.5 Responses Based on Highlighted Text
description:
The goal of this project is to develop a Chrome extension that allows users to highlight text within a webpage and use a custom keybinding to generate a GPT-3.5 response based on the highlighted text. The extension should then make it easy for users to paste the generated response into a document or input field.

The extension should include the following features:

Detect highlighted text: The extension should be able to detect when the user highlights text on a webpage and extract the highlighted content.
Custom keybinding: Users should be able to trigger the GPT-3.5 prompt generation by pressing a custom keybinding, such as "Command + F + U" or any other combination preferred by the client.
GPT-3.5 API integration: The extension should be able to send the highlighted text to the GPT-3.5 API, generate a specific prompt (e.g., "Make this sentence funny: [highlighted text]"), and receive the generated response from the API.
Copy response to clipboard: Once the GPT-3.5 response has been generated, the extension should automatically copy the response to the clipboard, allowing the user to paste it into a document or input field using the standard "paste" command (e.g., "Command + V").

Deliverables:

Complete and fully functional Chrome extension
Source code and any necessary documentation
Instructions for setting up and using the extension, including obtaining and integrating a GPT-3.5 API key
Please provide an estimated timeline and budget for the project, as well as examples of any relevant previous work or Chrome extensions you have developed.

Zeta is a next-generation banking-tech company on a mission to help our clients gain competitive advantage and independence from legacy systems to realize their digital strategies - whether that's launching a digital bank, offering new digital 1st payments services, or entering into emerging high-growth buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) and/or banking-as-a-service (BaaS) markets . We aim to be at the center of our clients' needs for next generation banking technology, so they can get their digital transformation and/or strategy right.

The Impact You Will Make
Reporting into the Senior Director, Solution Architect you will:
Liaise with large fintechs/banks - Become an SME of the functional architecture of the products subscribed by the clients and liaise with large enterprises to comprehend and understand how Zeta’s current solutions work for their product lines to help solve their use-cases. Participate in the regular sync-up meetings with client implementation teams to discuss solutions
Liaising with sales team - Work closely with sales teams to conceptualize concepts and solutions for clients
Liaising with product teams - Liaising with various product and program managers of Zeta to assess the cost and scope of changes a solution under consideration may require and arrive at feasible, optimal approaches for all business requirements. Frequent interactions with the Product teams to understand the product offerings, releases, and roadmap
Requirements specifications - Define and document detailed functional and non-functional requirements, integration and feature specifications, phase releases, and solutions to translate the functional mapping to Zeta’s product landscape. Ensure that the requirements specifications are defined and delivered unambiguously for the engineering teams to develop and deliver the software
Functional mapping - Functionally translate and map the business domain to a technological solution domain. Create high-level architecture and interaction diagrams between internal and external modules (e.g. DFDs, ERDs, UML, etc.) data flow diagrams to represent the data exchange between various modules
Identify constraints and dependencies - Highlight any long-term risks that may originate as a consequence of design or architectural choice made in the overall system design leading to an incomplete solution mapping and propose enhancements. Should also be able to highlight dependencies from client’s end which may act as blocker for deliverables from Zeta’s end
Communicating with internal stakeholders - Describe the structure, characteristics, behavior, and other aspects of the problem and solution to various project stakeholders
Implementation and delivery - Oversee the delivery of solutions while highlighting corner-cases where the implementation may be lacking. Be the point-of-contact for functional queries that would require domain-specific context to help unblock the team. Work with UAT teams to ensure the comprehensiveness and correctness of the delivered solution

Who We're Looking For
12+ years of experience as a Solution Architect or Analyst with services, consulting, or product companies
Experience in implementing any of the platforms - Tsys, Fiserv, First Data, Marqeta etc
Good domain knowledge of market landscape and understanding of core banking systems and related ecosystem of payments, credit card, issuing services, fraud, digital and related solutions.
Ability to comprehend complex technical products/solutions and prioritize/reason out trade-offs
Product mindset to effectively capture functional requirements and map them to the Product landscape/technical specifications
Excellent presentation skills and stakeholder management
Good experience in conducting workshops with large senior management groups and presenting solutions to a large audience
Ability to learn fast and adapt
Excellent written/verbal communication and interpersonal skills especially with external stakeholders
Ability to work on complex projects with a medium-to-high level of ambiguity
Excellent documentation skills - should be able to create detailed documents with relevant content (Data flow diagrams, flow charts, etc)
Excellent project management skills with past experience dealing with product managers, engineers, technical program managers, senior leaders
Good to have Engineering background in Information Technology or Computer Science
Prior experience in handling multiple large clients for complex projects is a plus
Strong stakeholder relationship management skills – able to influence and manage the expectations of senior executives internally and externally.
Ability to perform as an individual contributor (in-direct team leader) and as a manager with direct reports.
Strong ability, aptitude, and desire to network and to earn the confidence of diverse senior client leaders in marketing, sales, product, technology, operations, finance, and procurement functions.
Hands on, i.e. ‘roll-up-your sleeve’ type

Starts as part-time, initially. Converts to full-time based on (excellent) performance. 

Job Summary:
The Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) will lead the development and execution of the company's marketing strategy, branding, and customer acquisition initiatives. • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product, sales, and customer success, to develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns that drive business results.
• Establish and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including customers, partners, and industry influencers.
• Act as a thought leader in the industry, representing the company at industry events, conferences, and speaking engagements.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field. MBA preferred.
• 10+ years of marketing experience in the software and internet industry, with a focus on B2B marketing.
• Proven track record of developing and executing successful marketing strategies that drive business results.
• Strong leadership skills, with the ability to build and manage high-performing teams.
• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to communicate complex ideas and concepts to a variety of audiences.
• Analytical mindset with the ability to use data and metrics to make informed decisions.
• Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to achieve business objectives.
• Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize tasks effectively.
• Experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

The Chief Marketing Officer will play a critical role in shaping the company's brand and driving growth in the software and internet industry. The successful candidate will be a strategic thinker, a collaborative leader, and a results-oriented marketer with a passion for driving innovation and growth.

Requirements:

-Strong expertise in AI and machine learning, particularly with convolutional neural networks (CNNs)

-Experience with developing user interfaces for real-time data display
Strong programming skills in Python and C/C++

We are not seeking FULL dataset development. We would like to produce 1-2 datasets for demonstration and proof of concept. I.E. PVC conduit and HDPE gas line.

Talent will be working with our Electronics Engineer utilizing our proprietary PCB. 

We are open to suggestions/insight on latency, accuracy, or overall critical components of our development plan.

If you have a passion for developing cutting-edge AI solutions and have a track record of delivering high-quality results, we would love to hear from you! Please apply with your relevant experience and a portfolio of your work.

title: ESP32 embedded webserver
description:
I want to use the ESP32-S3 module with a USB port for a project. The ESP32 should boot from its flash and first detect if there is a USB pendrive plugged into it. If so it should copy two files - the executable file and the .HTML file from the pendrive to its flash. Then it should reboot, obviously now ignoring the pendrive and run a HTTPs secure webserver over WiFI in AP (access point) mode. 

Once a user logs in, the HTML file (about 250k) is served to the user, along with the application data from a 16384 byte RAM array on the ESP32 using the Websocket API. Changes made on the webpage by the user, usually using an Android tablet, also using the WebSocket API are stored in the RAM array, and also sent over the SPI bus to the rest of the system. 

At powerdown, indicated on a GPIO, the ESP32 needs to save the RAM array to flash.

If the file from the pendrive keeps crashing, it should revert to the previous executable which is also saved in the flash filing system.

System needs to run fairly quickly so proper C/C++ please, not Arduino, using the official API on the espressif.com website. Obviously you need to have an ESP32-S3 based module so please don't bid if you don't have one. The standard and S2 based modules aren't powerful enough (tried with a previous Freelancer project before S3 released)

I've just put this in the first price range so that people don't just bid the maximum amount but it obviously will cost more than this so please give an accurate quote, detailing your experience with the ESP32.

Like the targeting data above, without API this can only be downloaded by ad group. See sample 4. We’re a progressive startup in the igaming industry currently seeking an insightful front end developer to join our growing team of devs and creatives. The front end developer workload generally consists of working with Vue.js to implement front end components and building out pages using the components we’ve created in Storybook. You must be versatile and be able to pivot with the product as it continues to evolve. We use a cross functional approach for our team, so you will be working with various devs, creatives, etc to accomplish unified goals. Below is our stack with the required skills for this position:

Vue.JS 3 - 

This is the core skillset that is required for this position. Candidate MUST have commercial experience in component-driven development with reusable components, along with creating highly responsive layouts using current web standards for high traffic sites. Must also have experience leveraging server side rendering (SSR).

Storybook.js/Chromatic -

We use this to manage all components - must have prior experience working with it as our workflow is integrated with it, and we move at a fast pace.

Figma

All of our designs are created beforehand within Figma, so you must be able to use Figma efficiently and understand how to translate the designs into usable code.

Laravel 10 - 

Although you will not be doing much backend dev (if any at all), you will need experience working with Laravel, as this is the BE framework we are using which is integrated with Vue.JS as FE.

Serverless/AWS Lambda

Our project is completely event-driven and runs in a fully serverless environment. Due to this, you will need to have experience with how serverless architectures work as this affects how certain functions are used within Vue.js.

Javascript - 

Must have extensive experience working with vanilla JS as well as other JS runtimes including jQuery, AJAX and node.js. 

GraphQL - 

We utilize a single GraphQL endpoint for all data queries, so you will need to be very comfortable using it.

Git + Playwright + Vitest - 

Candidate must have experience working with a workflow that has continuous integration built into it. As part of this, you will need to have experience with integration testing and writing unit tests for validation with Vitest and Playwright. Must also understand how to use git efficiently.

Jira + Confluence + Slack - 

We use Jira as our project management software along with Confluence for documents. Slack is what we use for team communication.

This position will require a near full time schedule (30-40 hours). You should also be available for at least a short period of time daily to have discussions and status updates as needed. If you’ve made it this far and you feel that you’re a good candidate for the position, great! We look forward to meeting you -

title: UK Retailer Price Scraping Bot with Price Checking
description:
The bot will initially need to scrape 10 UK retailer websites (or for the larger sites just certain sections). It will need to perform this scrape on a Sunday afternoon (but I need to have the ability to change this as I see fit).

It will be important for the bot to have some sort of anti bot coding to ensure the IP’s are not banned. Whether this uses backdoor/API requests, user based clicks, time delays or limits on pages crawled per minute etc. 

It will need to gather information from all products on the site and store them in a .csv file or something else that I can alter and/or review in Excel. It needs to export the Product Name, URL, Current Price, EAN (if available), Timestamp etc. This will need to be exported to separate .csv files for each retailer.

Then the bot (maybe a separate programme) will then need to pull the URL’s from the files created above and check the prices. It is important that it compares the same URL’s/Products and there is no errors comparing different products. If the price is the same from the initial price gathered on the Sunday crawl then no action is taken. It will need to carry out this price check twice a day, 8am and then again at 3pm (I will need the ability to change the times or the number of times the prices are checked).

If there is a change in price then the bot will need to carry out the following actions;
1. Update a Discord server via a WebHook giving all product information, URL link and pricing information e.g. old price, new price and % difference.
2. It will then need to store this information on a separate daily .csv which will need to be emailed to me at a certain time in the day (when all scrapes have finished)
3. It will also need to amend the retailers .csv produced in the Sunday scrape so the current price is up to date, this will stop price changes flagging up again once a new price has been seen on the retailer site. It will also need to log timestamps for the latest price and when it was found.

I will give sample templates for fields needed in the .csv files but this can be open to some changes if it helps or needed.

In addition to the above I will likely need further sites doing as I expand the need for data for my analysis, so future work will also be given to the successful candidate.

title: Read my essay and correct any English mistakes
description:
echnical writing is a type of writing that is used to explain complex concepts, instructions, or information in a clear and concise manner. This type of writing is typically used in technical fields such as engineering, computer science, and healthcare, where accuracy and clarity are critical.

To write effective technical documents, it's important to keep the following tips in mind:

Know your audience: Understanding your audience is key to writing effective technical documents. You need to know who will be reading your document, their level of expertise, and what they hope to gain from reading it.

Use clear and concise language: Technical writing should be written in plain language, free of jargon, and easy to understand. Use short sentences, avoid unnecessary words, and make sure that your writing is easy to follow.

Use visuals: Visuals such as diagrams, charts, and graphs can help to clarify complex information and make it easier to understand. Use visuals to supplement your writing and make your document more engaging.

Follow a clear structure: Technical documents should follow a clear structure, with headings and subheadings that organize the information. Use bullet points and lists to break up large blocks of text and make your document more readable.

Proofread and edit: Technical writing should be free of errors, so it's important to proofread and edit your work carefully. Check for spelling and grammar errors, and make sure that your writing is consistent and well-organized.

Overall, technical writing is an essential skill for anyone working in a technical field. By following these tips, you can write effective technical documents that are clear, concise, and easy to understand.

title: UX/UI design project funding application portal
description:
We are seeking a UX/UI designer to create wireframes, visual designs, and UX and flow for a funding portal. The designer should aim to create an intuitive and user-friendly experience for potential grantees.

The project will involve creating wireframes and prototypes to test and refine the design of the portal. The designer should conduct user research to understand the needs and goals of potential grantees, and use this information to inform the design of the portal. The wireframes and prototypes should be used to solicit feedback from potential grantees and to iterate on the design as needed.

The designer should also create a visual design for the portal that is consistent with the branding and values of the organization. This includes designing a color scheme, typography, and other visual elements that create a cohesive and visually appealing experience.

In addition, the designer should create an information architecture that is easy to navigate and understand. This includes designing a clear and consistent navigation system, as well as organizing content in a logical and intuitive manner.

Overall, the UX/UI designer is responsible for creating a user-centered design that meets the needs of potential grantees and helps them navigate the grant application process with ease. The designer should work closely with the development team to ensure that the design is implemented effectively and efficiently.

The project:

The funding portal will be designed with a variety of features to streamline the grant application process and enable effective communication between the organization and potential grantees.

One key feature will be a login system that allows applicants to create a secure account and access the various forms and resources available on the portal.

Another critical feature will be the various forms available to potential grantees. These will include a pre-application form, which will allow applicants to provide basic information about their project and receive feedback before submitting a full application. The full application form will be comprehensive, enabling applicants to provide detailed information about their project, budget, timeline, expected outcomes, and more. In addition, there will be an application form specifically for donations, allowing individuals and organizations to make contributions directly to supported projects. Finally, the portal will feature a transfer application form, enabling current grantees to request additional funding or make adjustments to their grant.

The funding portal will also feature robust file management capabilities. Applicants will be able to upload all necessary documents and materials through the portal, ensuring that the organization has all the information it needs to make informed decisions about grant applications. The portal will also allow for easy tracking and management of all grant-related documents, such as project proposals, budgets, and reporting materials.

Overall, the funding portal will be an essential tool for ensuring effective communication and efficient grant management. By providing a streamlined process for submitting grant applications, managing files, and communicating with potential grantees, the portal will help the organization achieve its mission of making a positive impact in the community.

title: Create a sweepstake campaign that include Landing Page, use of watssap to generate winer
description:
Sweepstake Name: "Lab Launch Lottery"
Slogan: "Empowering Haiti's Lab Technicians for a Brighter Future"

Overview:
The Lab Launch Lottery is a sweepstake aimed at supporting lab technicians in Haiti, by offering them a chance to win a full set of laboratory equipment provided by Solima. This initiative will not only help the lucky winner start their first lab, but also help us gather data on lab technicians in Haiti, fostering a stronger professional network in the country.

Marketing Plan:

Target Audience:
Lab technicians in Haiti who are first-time buyers, and who are ready to invest a minimum of 15,000 HTG for a chance to win the grand prize.

WhatsApp Campaign:
Since the majority of Haitians prefer using WhatsApp over visiting websites, we will focus on creating a WhatsApp-based marketing campaign.

a. Create a WhatsApp Business Account: Set up an official WhatsApp Business account for the Lab Launch Lottery, ensuring easy communication with potential participants and providing a platform to receive sweepstake entries.

b. Develop Engaging Content: Craft attractive images, videos, and text messages that explain the sweepstake's details, benefits, and rules, emphasizing the grand prize, entry requirements, and the objective of gathering lab technician data in Haiti.

c. Utilize WhatsApp Groups: Identify and join relevant WhatsApp groups where lab technicians and related professionals are members, and share the Lab Launch Lottery promotional content in these groups.

d. Encourage Sharing: Ask existing participants to share the promotional content within their own networks, offering them additional chances to win for every successful referral.

e. Utilize WhatsApp Status Updates: Regularly post updates about the sweepstake on the Lab Launch Lottery's WhatsApp status, to keep participants informed and engaged.

Partnerships:
Collaborate with educational institutions, professional associations, and other organizations in Haiti that are involved in training or supporting lab technicians. Encourage them to promote the Lab Launch Lottery within their networks and help identify potential participants.

Local Media Outreach:
Leverage local newspapers, radio stations, and other media outlets to create awareness about the Lab Launch Lottery and its objectives, further extending the reach of our marketing campaign.

Timelines and Deadlines:
Establish clear timelines for the sweepstake, including the start and end dates for entries, the date of the raffle draw, and the announcement of the winner.

Data Collection and Management:
Ensure a secure and organized system for collecting and managing the data of lab technicians who participate in the sweepstake. This information will be valuable for future marketing campaigns, as well as fostering professional connections within Haiti's lab technician community.

By following this marketing plan, we can effectively promote the Lab Launch Lottery, gather valuable data on lab technicians in Haiti, and ultimately support the growth and development of Haiti's scientific community.

title: Need Senior Lead Game Designer
description:
A game developer is responsible for designing, creating, and programming video games for a variety of platforms, including consoles, computers, mobile devices, and virtual reality systems. The job description of a game developer may vary depending on the size and scope of the company or project they are working on, but here are some common duties and responsibilities:
- Game design: Collaborating with a team of artists, 
 writers, and other developers to come up with game 
 concepts, mechanics, and storylines that will engage 
 and entertain players.
- Programming: Using programming languages like C++, 
 Java, or Python to create the software that runs the 
 game and handles player interactions.
- Graphics and animation: Creating 2D or 3D models, 
 textures, and animations to give the game a visually. 
 appealing and immersive look and feel.
- User interface and user experience design: Designing 
 intuitive menus, controls, and interfaces that allow 
 players to easily navigate the game and enjoy a 
 smooth and seamless experience.
- Quality assurance: Testing the game extensively to 
 identify and fix bugs, glitches, and other issues that 
 could affect gameplay or user experience.
 Project management: Collaborating with project 
 managers, producers, and other team members to 
 ensure that the game is developed on time and within 
 budget.
- Research and development: Keeping up-to-date with 
 the latest technologies and trends in the gaming 
 industry, and exploring new ways to improve the 
 gameplay and user experience of the game.

Overall, a game developer needs to be creative, analytical, and technically skilled, with a strong passion for gaming and a desire to create fun, engaging, and innovative games that will captivate players around the world.

title: Kafka and Scala expertise required
description:
Hi

We recently purchased a company whose technology is based on Kafka. This is not a skillset we have in our company.

We require a person/team to work parttime to assist us in maintaining and adding to this product. The project will run for at least 3-6 months and should have 10-20 hours a week of work

The product is hosted by Google. It has native Android and iOS apps. 

In the meantime, here's a bulletpoint level description from the previous owners

* Clients are both a javascript web app running react and mobile 
clients running react native. Not much code shared between them.
* The clients talk to a GraphQL based API server written in javascript
* The backend architecture is a CQRS model, this means that the API 
server reads its state from a mongodb database, but to make changes it 
publishes events to our event logs - which are all in Kafka
* Various separate services written in Scala listen to the incoming 
events from kafka and publish updated state back to kafka, this updated 
state is then written back out to mongodb for the API server to read

title: Build a machine learning model
description:
Our app integrated with Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs) and other wearables to track users metabolic health. Using the app, users will log their meals, including the nutritional content of the meals. We will then score those meals based on the 2 hour 'post prandial' glucose response to that meal. A CGM is only used for 2 weeks, and then is disposed. 

We have 1,000s of food logs and 100,000s of glucose readings in our database. We would like to develop a model that ingests that data, and can then make predictions about an individuals glucose data without the need for a CGM.

Step one: Develop a machine learning model using a labeled data set from the group 

Step two: New user signs up and wears a CGM for 2 weeks. This data is used to "personalise" the model for that individual. After the two weeks, the user would continue to log their food in the app, and the model would make predictions about their '2 hour post prandial' glucose response to that food, completely eliminating the need for another CGM to be worn

Looking for a machine learning expert who has experience in health and has strong english skills.

title: Wordpress, Woocommerce, Dokan and AffiliateWP Expert
description:
Hello Freelancers,

I seek an expert developer with WordPress, WooCommerce, Dokan and Affiliate WP experience.

We currently use WordPress, Woocommere and Dokan to run a multivendor marketplace/platform with vendors and customers. Currently, Dokan does not have an affiliates module. We'd like to create an affiliate module from scratch or implement an existing Affiliate plugin like AffiliateWP oer something similar.

Overall Features:
- Vendors on our platform should be able to sign up to be an affiliate
- Once approved, the vendor can determine which events/products can be used within the affiliate program via their vendor affiliate program portal
- Affiliates can sign up to be a part of a vendor's affiliate program or the vendor can manually sign up users/affiliates to be a part of their affiliate program
- Affiliates can manage all aspects of their program involvement via an affiliates dashboard
- The affiliate program will create links for vendors to share with affiliates. When an affiliate shares their affiliate link with a friend, if that friend purchases, the affiliate will receive credit for the purchase as seen in their dashboard/portal
- The vendor should know how many purchases have occurred at all times through the various affiliate links/coupons
The Vendor should be able to pay out vendors using Stripe, PayPal, manually, etc
- The affiliate can use promo codes to track usage and affiliate commission
- Vendors and affiliates can see their commission statistics in a dashboard
- Display affiliate statistics in vendor and affiliate profile dashboard
- Associate promo codes and links to products/events with vendors 

Here is an example of this will work with a real business scenario:

We hire entertainers (vocalists) to sing at our venue. In addition to paying them to perform, we pay them to market the event.

The process is as follows:

1. We assign each entertainer a unique affiliate link to the event, including all or specific ticket types

2. The entertainers share their affiliate link with their social network, friends, family, etc.

3. Customers click on the affiliate link to RSVP for free or purchase a ticket (WooCommerce Product)

4. The entertainer can open their personal dashboard to track their efforts and see sales, affiliate earnings, payouts, etc.

5. With RSVPs, we check in customers at the door, which automatically shows us the efforts of the entertainers.

I look forward to speaking more about this project and learning your ideas to make this work. We essentially want to make an affiliate plugin or custom affiliate plugin work with Dokan and Woocommerce.

title: Convert SSAS MultiDimensional Cube to SSAS Tabular
description:
I have a SSAS MultiDimensional cube that needs to be re-written as a SSAS Tabular model.
This cube works fine, but because it is MultiDim, Power BI does not let users create custom in-report calculations.

The cube has General Ledger (GL) data, so there are GL Accounts, GL Activity and GL Balances etc.

There are 7 dimensions and 2 measure groups that link to their dimensions differently.
There is one data source - an SQL Server database.
The cube is not very large…
• Biggest fact table has 2,000,000 rows
• Biggest dimension has 1,000 rows

…but the cube does have some complexities:
• 5 Account Trees (Parent-Child Hierarchies of GL Accounts). These trees have unary operators.
• Because a GL Account can be in multiple Account Trees, there is a many-to-many relationship between DimGlAccountTree and FactGlBalances
• The 5 Account Trees are not available for all Business Units (BU’s). Some BU’s can use 2 trees, others can use 4

title: SQL Developer for Postgres SQL Transformations
description:
We are healthcare recruitment platform based in the UK, seeking a skilled SQL Developer to join our team to work on a project to migrate our Google Sheets product data analytics table into Postgres.

We have a large number of data tables that we currently output to Google Sheets directly from our product. These data tables are then transformed using complex Excel formula. This includes, for example, joining data from two data tables within one Google Sheet.

We are hitting a number of performance and size limitations within Google Sheets, so are looking to build a more performant and scaleable solution within Postgres by doing the following:.

1) Migration from Product to Raw Postgres DB
2) Postgres transformation from Raw to Transformed (SQL)
3) Transformed Postgres migrated to Google Sheets for analytics.

You will be responsible for Step 2 - building a series of intermediate SQL transformations within Postgres for export into Google Sheets.

This is an initial 10-15 hour project with potential for ongoing maintenance and new projects following on from this.

Responsibilities:

- Write SQL queries from a Postgres SQL database to build a series of transformed tables which will be exported to Excel for analytics
- Collaborate with the team to design and implement SQL transformations, including Joins, Counts, Aggregations, Filters, and more
- Troubleshoot any issues that may arise during the transformation process
- Ensure all transformations are optimized for performance and scalability
- Work closely with other teams to ensure the data is correctly transformed and exported
- Maintain and update the SQL queries as needed

Requirements:

- Excellent knowledge of SQL and experience with Postgres database architecture, minimum 2 years experience
- A good understanding of Excel formula, to be able to translate Excel formula into SQL
- Experience working with large data sets and designing database schemas
- A strong understanding of SQL best practices and database architecture
- Familiarity with Postgres limitations and the ability to optimize queries accordingly
- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills
- The ability to work in a fast-paced environment and respond quickly to requests and changes

To be considered for this role, candidates will be required to complete a short assessment to test their SQL and Excel skills. This will help us to understand your proficiency level and ensure it is matched to what the project requires.

We're a performance/growth marketing agency based in NYC with a client who is an e-mobility (foldable electric vehicle) startup based in the UK, and launching in the US. The client just raised $800k on Indiegogo and secured another round of seed funding in private equity.

Our role is managing omnichannel campaign strategy, operations, and execution. We handle all paid and owned media: Meta (FB/IG), TikTok, Google, programmatic display, OOH, OTT, native advertising, content marketing, email marketing (Klaviyo). As well as data analytics and insights, data warehousing/visualization, ad creative/development, and general operations.

We'll be spending roughly $250k monthly across all paid media in the first 3 months, with that figure scaling up alongside sales performance. Google will command somewhere around $80-100k in monthly spend across all placements and formats (performance max, shopping, search, YouTube, display, discovery).

We're looking for someone who can come in with a deep and complete understanding of the Google Ads platform, best practices, and intimate knowledge of algorithmic learning/rank optimization, and ad creative best practices.

We don't need someone to do all of the strategic thinking, that's where we come in. However, we do need someone who knows how best to achieve the strategic goals we describe through their experience in tactical ad operations on the platform. So we'll tell you generally how we want the campaign architecture built, and you'll tell us specifically how we should approach actually building it.

This will be a month-to-month project with a flat monthly retainer and a performance bonus incentive for highly qualified/experienced candidates. There is potential for longterm contractual relationships, and even potentially more work through our agency should things go well.

Looking forward to hearing from you!

Hello! We're a Health Marketing Firm that's sold over $10M of health supplements and info products in functional, natural health and we're looking for an amazing copywriter to join part time and hopefully full time shortly after.

You will have many tasks, but only one job - to INCREASE SALES by writing more compelling, clear copy that our customers love to read.

You must provide samples of a long form VSL, a Long Form Sales Page and email sequences you’ve written before.
You must be fluent in English.
This role can be 20 to 40 hours a week depending on your availability.

--------------------------------------------------------
What you’ll be doing every week:
--------------------------------------------------------

You’ll be doing a lot of research on Google, YouTube, PubMed about our topics to come up with ideas and interesting hooks about "leaky gut"

You’ll be spending many hours looking for insights and copy ideas from Reviews left by customers, Comments on Instagram posts, comments on Facebook posts and Customer Support tickets

You’ll spend many hours investigating competition to see what they're doing very well and how we can use their copy or ideas to make our products and marketing better and more helpful

You’ll be creating 10 mini handoff funnels from major conditions and showing the reader how that condition could be aided by our program and solution.
 For each condition there will be…
 10 60 second video ad scripts for Facebook and Instagram Reels
 10 opening hooks for each video
 A headline and supporting body copy for the landing page that echoes the ad and signs them up for the webinar

You will be writing our weekly newsletter to our hundreds of thousands of subscribes
 Each week will be 3 emails and in each email you will need to…
 You will need to follow our process for assembling really interesting information on healthy living in your 50s as a woman
 You will source this content from YouTube, TikTok, Reels, our website, our social media looking for content that has lots of engagement and resharing it on email
 You will write 10 versions of ads for every one of our Product or Affiliate offers
 You will assemble each email with 3 incredibly relevant, helpful pieces of information and then use one of the versions for one of the Product or Affiliate offers in the email so every email will contain helpful advice and an offer to purchase something.

You will be writing new versions of ads, hooks or landing pages every week with our Creative Director
 You must be ok with writing many versions of headlines and body copy and not worry about some versions not getting used in the final product

You will be sending out segment surveys to buyers and non buyers to gain information on how we could sell better by increasing clarity, handling objections and answering questions.

You are someone who is DATA FOCUSED who knows writing from intuition and research is the best place to start, but that the data is what tells us if it's working or not. We measure almost everything and will expect you to use that data on EVERY iteration of new copy we create

You will be required to read through our Customer Support tickets and chat logs looking for interesting ideas and what things our customers are seeking to learn that we can put in Video Scripts, Ads, Landing Pages and Emails to make our funnels more clear, compelling, helpful and delightful.

title: Developer to create a script that export data from Magento and import them into Adobe Illustrator

Phase 1
Create a script that will export fields from Magento and import them into Adobe Illustrator 
Operator will have already opened up illustrator file independently from script
Will need to export fields from Magento and import them to corresponding field in Illustrator
Fields typically are line(s) of text

Export Fields from Magento and import into Illustrator

Operator will input orders into UI by scanning a barcode on the order form
Order(s) Scanned/Entered in UI, UI will list all Products included on orders
Sort products descending by total quantity of units.
Develop program that will will locate Offer ID from searching for orders in Magento from order # s
Program will cross reference Offer IDs in a separate database table to get a list of Product ID and Unit Quantity. 
UI will list specific fields located in a separate database table.
Product ID
Total Unit Quantity
Material Settings
Z Settings
Plate ID #
User will be able to select specific product from UI
UI will list out Order # and Offer ID for each selected
User will select specific Offer ID and UX/UI will open corresponding Illustrator file
Illustrator File will be determined based upon a separate database table.
Program will import fields from Magento into Illustrator
Program will locate Orders in Magento from Order # Selected
Transfer specific populated fields from Magento and import them into specific fields in Illustrator

Phase 4
Program will be able to export completed work into a separate database that will allow query searches.
